== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-nathan-russell-ls-hyperdrive-v/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Russell LS HyperdriveV.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114040155/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-nathan-russell-ls-hyperdrive-v.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>f1467f88fc2063955db9fc7f29d9b25b203fb56a1a70e8aafde3765f1d377a84</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Ahsoka Tano With Lightsabers (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>301_1^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (ALT) (Virtual Set 0) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_146</nowiki>. The published list says <nowiki>1x Master Qui-Gon (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The linked AI/ALT belongs to the same card family and its engine gameplay record matches the ordinary image after excluding image-identity fields.
* 2x [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V) (ALT) (Virtual Set 0) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_145</nowiki>. The published list says <nowiki>2x Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The linked AI/ALT belongs to the same card family and its engine gameplay record matches the ordinary image after excluding image-identity fields.
* 1x [[Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>11_14</nowiki>. The published list says <nowiki>1x Threepio With His Parts Showing (AI)</nowiki>. The linked AI/ALT belongs to the same card family and its engine gameplay record matches the ordinary image after excluding image-identity fields.
* 1x [[Resolute (ALT)]]: XML <nowiki>221_71^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[Jedi Lightsaber (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>211_33^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
